snippet.title: EverSiege: Untold Ages | Release date trailer (FYNG2025)
snippet.description:
Bastion is calling you to break the siege. EverSiege: Untold Ages launches on February 3rd on Steam and the Epic Games Store, with the demo arriving on December 15.
Wishlist now: https://eversiegegame.com/

⚔️ What is EverSiege about?
Two centuries after the world fell, Bastion still stands.
Once banished by the ancient gods, you are summoned to break the EVERSIEGE.
Each run forces hard choices — what to rebuild, what to spare, which power to pursue.
Wield legendary weapons, pair them with elemental Essences, and craft your playstyle through evolving challenges. Rebuild Bastion, manage your resources, and hold the line against relentless hordes while striking deep into enemy territory.

EverSiege: Untold Ages is brought to life by Tindalos Interactive and by Dear Villagers.

Follow us:
• X: https://x.com/PlayEverSiege
• Discord: https://discord.gg/eversiege
• BlueSky: https://bsky.app/profile/eversiegegame.com
• Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/EverSiege/
• Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/playeversiege
